description: This file implements a SOCKS proxy server and client logic, including connection handling, pattern matching for proxy rules, and event-driven communication for managing socket requests, data transfer, and errors within the Playwright project.

classes.name: SocksConnection
classes.description: Handles individual SOCKS protocol connection, including authentication, request parsing, and data forwarding.

classes.name: SocksProxy
classes.description: Implements the SOCKS proxy server, managing incoming connections, pattern matching, and socket requests.

classes.name: SocksProxyHandler
classes.description: Manages SOCKS client requests, pattern matching, and socket creation, acting as an event emitter for network events.

methods.name: setPattern
methods.description: Sets the pattern for proxy rule matching.

methods.name: _handleDirect
methods.description: Handles direct socket connection bypassing the proxy based on request.

methods.name: port
methods.description: Returns the listening port of the SOCKS server.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the SOCKS server listening on specified port and hostname.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the SOCKS server and all active connections.

methods.name: onSocketRequested
methods.description: Handles incoming socket request events, either proxying or direct connection.

methods.name: onSocketData
methods.description: Handles incoming data from sockets and emits appropriate events.

methods.name: onSocketClosed
methods.description: Handles socket closure events and cleans up resources.

methods.name: sendSocketData
methods.description: Sends data through a socket identified by UID.

methods.name: sendSocketEnd
methods.description: Ends a socket connection identified by UID.

methods.name: socketRequested
methods.description: Handles client request for socket connection, either creating a new socket or emitting failure.

methods.name: sendSocketData
methods.description: Sends data to a socket identified by UID.

methods.name: socketClosed
methods.description: Handles socket closure and resource cleanup.
